subject: A'lai
fact: A'lai is a drow with Underdark connections, possibly Menzoberranzan connections, currently holding a conspiracy that ended a man's life and was dismantled in a single afternoon, and he pays in knowledge, not gold or books.
source_quote: A'lai, moreover, is a drow. He might have information that Daz needs.

subject: Janussi
fact: Janussi spent his last day in a library full of people who had already decided they'd won, and offered each of them one more reason on his way through — he was dead by midnight.
source_quote: Janussi had spent his last day in a library full of people who had already decided, and he had offered each of them one more reason on his way through.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is a place where finding a spell was simply a matter of calling up the right avowed to bring a scroll from somewhere, and where budgetary pressures and workforce restructuring were used to frame assassination.
source_quote: At Candlekeep, finding such a spell was simply a matter of calling up the right avowed to bring you a scroll from somewhere.

subject: poisoned book
fact: The poisoned book was reclaimed from Daral and contained evidence tied to Janussi's death and the conspiracy.
source_quote: a poisoned book reclaimed from Daral

subject: Grygum's carefully reassembled wrapping paper
fact: Grygum's carefully reassembled wrapping paper was part of the recovered evidence, likely concealing or containing hidden notes or seals.
source_quote: Grygum's carefully reassembled wrapping paper

subject: note in Janussi's own hand
fact: The note in Janussi's own hand, found on the third floor, contained his final records or confessions related to the conspiracy.
source_quote: a note in Janussi's own hand found on the third floor

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is a city where you do not accumulate many enemies before the city resolves the problem for you, and where blackmail is treated as a career and history is rewritten as administrative efficiency.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, you do not get to accumulate that many enemies before the city resolves the problem for you.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is an entity or organization paying Menzoberranzan rates to keep a nobody drow evoker alive and functional, and its identity remains unknown despite months of investigation.
source_quote: Someone powerful was paying to protect a man she couldn't understand.

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan was the party who had been wronged, had standing, and was presumably motivated to be thorough — he was the one fired and now held a complete account.
source_quote: Kalan had been standing just outside through all of it, which meant the man who'd been fired now held a rather complete account.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist gave the accounting of the conspiracy: A'lai set it in motion, and he carried it out, and he was the hand that executed the plan.
source_quote: Alkrist had given us the accounting of it: A'lai as the one who set it in motion, himself as the hand that carried it out.

subject: workforce restructuring at Candlekeep
fact: Workforce restructuring at Candlekeep was used as a narrative to frame Janussi's assassination as an administrative decision, aligning with A'lai's constructed history.
source_quote: File the assassination under *workforce restructuring*. Enter it in the column marked *organizational efficiency*.

subject: conspiracy dismantled in a single afternoon
fact: The conspiracy that ended Janussi's life was dismantled in a single afternoon by the group, exposing A'lai and the hidden motives behind the murder.
source_quote: a conspiracy that had ended a man's life and that we had dismantled in a single afternoon

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin insisted on collecting a book per suspect and proposed handing the evidence to Kalan to clean house, believing the tools should go to the wronged party.
source_quote: I'm gonna insist that we get a book per suspect... Give it to him, let him clean house.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum introduced blackmail as an agenda item and noted that in murder mysteries, someone often treats blackmail as a kind of career, aligning with A'lai's profile.
source_quote: We could always decide to blackmail one or more of them... you often find somebody who treats blackmail as a kind of career.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir confirmed the obvious — Kalan was here, and the group had enough to act — and aligned with Thorin’s position on the evidence.
source_quote: Zalthir confirmed the obvious. "He's here."

subject: third floor
fact: The third floor of Candlekeep is where Janussi's final note was found, containing critical evidence tied to the conspiracy.
source_quote: a note in Janussi's own hand found on the third floor

subject: budget day at Candlekeep
fact: Budget day at Candlekeep was the day Janussi was killed, used as cover for a targeted elimination under the guise of fiscal restraint.
source_quote: Budget day. Review day. The day careers were made or broken.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira told the investigator bluntly that someone powerful was paying to protect a man she couldn't understand, initiating the months-long column with one blank entry.
source_quote: Kaelira told me bluntly that someone powerful was paying to protect a man she couldn't understand.

subject: the column
fact: The column maintained since Kaelira's revelation had one entry — a blank patron — and remained unresolved until A'lai emerged as the first real lead.
source_quote: That column had one entry, and I still couldn't name the entity.

subject: blackmail as a career
fact: Blackmail as a career is a known pattern in murder mysteries, and A'lai's actions reflect this — he constructs history as administrative efficiency to mask criminal intent.
source_quote: you often find somebody who treats blackmail as a kind of career... the man who treats blackmail as a kind of career knows how to make his own history sound administrative.

subject: A'lai
fact: A'lai is the most reliably underpriced resource in the world because he knows what others have done and has chosen not to use it — that is the only price I am interested in collecting.
source_quote: What he knows about whoever is paying Menzoberranzan rates to keep a nobody drow evoker alive and functional: that is the only price I am interested in collecting.
